events.label: Hochul appoints Letitia James special prosecutor in Cornell case

slots.name: case oversight
slots.sentence: The announcement means District Attorney Matthew Van Houten is no longer overseeing the case.

slots.name: special prosecutor assignment
slots.sentence: New York Governor Kathy Hochul has appointed the state's attorney general, Letitia James, as a special prosecutor in investigating the alleged gang rape of a woman at Cornell University.

events.label: Hochul and James scheduled Cornell case update

slots.name: alleged assailants
slots.sentence: “In what world would the police learn from a victim that she’d been literally gang-raped while intoxicated by five men in a fraternity house, and not elevate those allegations to the district attorney,” Hochul said, of the alleged assaults.

slots.name: investigation status
slots.sentence: “We will review the facts, gather evidence, interview witnesses and, if warranted, pursue prosecutions,” James said at the news conference.

slots.name: reported victim confidence
slots.sentence: "According to new reports, she could not have been clearer that she was 100 percent confident that she had been raped. Yet, shockingly, those words never made it into the account that Cornell police sent to prosecutors," Hochul said.

slots.name: alleged perpetrators

slots.name: appointed investigator
slots.sentence: Hochul, reading from prepared remarks, confirmed that she has appointed New York Attorney General Letitia James to carry out a “fresh and thorough review” of all the facts in the case nearly two years after a district attorney declined to pursue criminal charges.
